Massive props to Ben Lang from Cursor for providing credits and Juan Bautista Martinez , Daniel Huss , & Travis Austin for judging through 2 HOURS of back-to-back demos. RIP to my Snowflake Fall internship 🥲❄️ After months of trying, successfully passing all the interviews, waiting for headcount, and finally seeing everything come together, my Fall internship ended up being blocked by something I honestly didn’t expect: a start-date conflict. As a student on the quarter system, my summer CPT overlaps with Snowflake’s required Fall internship start window, and unfortunately there was no way to make the transition work. We tried pretty much every option we could think of, but sometimes timing just doesn’t work out. Definitely heartbreaking after making it this far 🥲 A small PSA for fellow international students at quarter-system schools: double-check Fall internship start dates and CPT timelines as early as possible! Huge thanks to everyone at Snowflake who helped and advocated for me along the way. ❄️ :) #Snowflake #Internship #CPT #InternationalStudents #SoftwareEngineering

My first PR to PyTorch got merged this week, and I'm genuinely happy about it. It fixes a memory bottleneck in torch.nonzero on Apple silicon, peak GPU memory on large tensors drops from 12 GiB to 3.8 GiB, up to 33% faster. It also un-flakes a CI test and makes some large-tensor code paths testable on ordinary hardware. It ships with the next release, which is a pretty cool feeling for a first contribution. I came in knowing very little about how a codebase this size actually works, and the process taught me a lot, my C++ got sharper, I picked up Metal, learned a ton on parallel programming, and concepts from my OS and architecture classes translated pretty well and finally became concrete. I also came away really liking how open source works. Clear contribution docs, patient reviewers, and a process that genuinely gives first-timers a chance. Big thanks to Edward Yang , whose "PyTorch internals" blog post carried my whole onboarding, and to the PyTorch MPS maintainers for the fast and helpful review. Definitely not my last contribution. PR: https://lnkd.in/gVrMiAUn #PyTorch #OpenSource #GPU #Metal
